## ForeignKeyDefinition interface

> This API is provided as a beta preview for developers and may change based on feedback that we receive. Do not use this API in a production environment.
> 

The target and behaviour of a column's foreign key.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface ForeignKeyDefinition 
```

## Remarks

Built by [ColumnDefinition.references()](./database.columndefinition.references.md) and [ColumnDefinition.constrained()](./database.columndefinition.constrained.md) rather than written by hand. Constraints are emitted inside `CREATE TABLE`<!-- -->, because sqlite cannot add them afterwards.
